title: Dibutyl phthalate exposure-induced AhR activation drives ferroptosis and HMGB1/TLR4-mediated inflammatory liver injury via NRF2-HO-1 signaling.
authors: Li, Zixu; Xu, Muge; Zhang, Yahan; Chen, Yao; Feng, Weiwei; Zhao, Ting; Yang, Liuqing; Mao, Guanghua; Wu, Xiangyang
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨DBP暴露通过AhR-NRF2/HO-1信号诱导铁死亡和炎症性肝损伤，涉及分子对接但核心为毒理学机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The widespread presence of plastic pollutants, particularly phthalate esters such as dibutyl phthalate (DBP), poses a significant threat to both ecosystems and human health. Despite the accumulating evidence of DBP toxicity, the mechanisms driving DBP-induced hepatotoxicity remain poorly understood. In this study, an integrated approach combining network toxicology, molecular docking, and multidimensional experimental validation was applied to elucidate the molecular pathways through which DBP causes liver damage. Ferroptosis was identified as a central player in DBP-induced hepatotoxicity. The results showed that DBP activates the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR), regulating the NRF2/HO-1 signaling axis, which in turn induces iron overload and lipid peroxidation. Furthermore, ferroptotic hepatocytes release high-mobility group box 1 (HMGB1), activating the TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway in macrophages and amplifying inflammatory responses that exacerbate liver injury. Crucially, inhibition of either AhR expression or ferroptosis significantly attenuated these changes, highlighting the potential of AhR and ferroptosis as therapeutic targets. Together, these findings establish a novel mechanistic framework for DBP-induced hepatotoxicity: the AhR-NRF2/HO-1-ferroptosis-HMGB1/TLR4 axis. This study advances our understanding of plasticizer toxicity and offers insights for risk assessment and intervention strategies for combating environmental hepatotoxins.
abstract_zh: 塑料污染物的广泛存在，尤其是邻苯二甲酸酯类如邻苯二甲酸二丁酯（DBP），对生态系统和人类健康构成了重大威胁。尽管DBP毒性的证据不断积累，但驱动DBP诱导肝毒性的机制仍知之甚少。本研究采用网络毒理学、分子对接和多维实验验证相结合的综合方法，阐明DBP导致肝损伤的分子通路。铁死亡（ferroptosis）被确定为DBP诱导肝毒性的核心因素。结果表明，DBP激活芳烃受体（aryl hydrocarbon receptor, AhR），调控NRF2/HO-1信号轴，进而诱导铁过载和脂质过氧化。此外，铁死亡肝细胞释放高迁移率族蛋白B1（HMGB1），激活巨噬细胞中的TLR4/NF-kappaB通路，放大炎症反应，加剧肝损伤。关键的是，抑制AhR表达或铁死亡均显著减轻这些变化，凸显了AhR和铁死亡作为治疗靶点的潜力。综合来看，这些发现为DBP诱导肝毒性建立了一个新的机制框架：AhR-NRF2/HO-1-铁死亡-HMGB1/TLR4轴。本研究增进了我们对增塑剂毒性的理解，并为应对环境肝毒素的风险评估和干预策略提供了见解。
